name: AMS1117-3.3 3.3V 1A LDO SOT-223 C6186
label: AMS1117-3.3
source: JLCPCB parts library page https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/C6186 read 2026-11-10 (Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117-3.3, SOT-223, library type Basic) ; LCSC product page https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C6186.html read 2026-11-10 (same mpn and package) ; datasheet: Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117 (the copy LCSC links for C6186, 8 pages, no revision or date printed, PDF creation date 2009-08-27, SHA-256 189a2651878a; pages counted from the first) ; vout.voltage: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS, page 2, 'Output Voltage' AMS1117-3.3, Vin = 4.8 V, Iout = 0 mA: the boldface line, which the table says applies over the full operating temperature range (note under the table, page 3): min 3.201 V, max 3.399 V (typ 3.300 V; the 25 C line is 3.251 V to 3.349 V) ; dropout: page 3, 'Dropout Voltage (Vin - Vout)', delta Vout = 1%, Iout = 0.8 A (note 4): typ 1.1 V, max 1.3 V ; max_power: page 3, note 2, 'guaranteed up to the maximum power dissipation of 1.2 W for SOT-223' ; temp_min, temp_max: page 2, ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM RATINGS, operating junction temperature range -40 C to 125 C (control section and power transistor); the catalog column is a range of the junction, not the ambient ; max_current: see notes
notes: Advanced Monolithic Systems. Fixed 3.3 V, SOT-223 with the tab as the output (page 1, 'TAB IS OUTPUT'); pins 1 = Ground/Adjust, 2 = VOUT, 3 = VIN (page 1), the LinearRegulator pin table of std. max_current is 0.8 A, the highest current at which the datasheet states the dropout and the load regulation (notes 3 and 4, page 3); the datasheet's other figures are 'Output Current of 1A' (page 1) and a current limit of 900 mA minimum, 1100 typical and 1500 maximum at Vin - Vout = 1.5 V (page 3); JLCPCB lists 1 A. Minimum load current 5 mA typical and 10 mA maximum (page 3 and its note 5: the device is guaranteed to regulate only if the output current is greater than 10 mA); the output voltage line is stated at Iout = 0 mA. Quiescent current 5 mA typical and 11 mA maximum (page 3): the catalog has no column for it, so a board states it (.quiescent_current &= 0mA..11mA). Absolute maximum input voltage 15 V (page 2). Not read: the package drawing (the datasheet's SOT-223 drawing was not used; the pads are the generator's).
